decoder: ffmpeg version 8.0 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers
corpus: LibriSpeech dev-clean + test-clean; dev-other + test-other speaker-disjoint validation (OpenSLR 12, CC BY 4.0)
selection: Sorted speaker/chapter/utterance; first four utterances at least 6 s; first three with at least 3 s Silero speech at both 48000 and 44100 Hz. Each pair uses different utterances. Rate renders and pairs are correlated, not independent trials.

margin.rule: 99.9th percentile of pooled dev-clean and test-clean impostor scores at both rates (linear interpolation at (n-1)*0.999) + max(0.002, measured cross-runtime drift), rounded up to 0.01 using decimal ceiling. Freeze before disjoint validation. Publish only if every corpus/rate has FAR <= 0.005 and same-speaker pass >= 0.95.
margin.driftBasis: Not applicable: all embeddings and cosine scores use the production Swift helper and official ONNX Runtime 1.19.2 CPU; no Python scoring path. The 0.002 floor remains in force.

limitations: Calibration pairs share speakers and clips; rate renders are not independent recordings. Counts are not independent statistical trials.
Clean calibration and disjoint harder read-speech validation are not microphone acceptance, spoof resistance or a held-out field-accuracy claim.
User own-voice check on this Mac microphone is owed.
